mapper.sql: m.id, m.image_id, i.image_no AS image_code, i.image_url, m.atlas_id, a.atlas_no AS atlas_code, a.image_url AS atlas_image_url, COALESCE(m.species_id, a.species_id) AS species_id, COALESCE(m.herb_name, s.herb_name) AS species_name, m.image_similarity AS similarity_score, m.match_rank, m.match_level AS match_result, m.remark AS match_batch_no, m.created_at AS match_time, m.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_image_match ( image_id, recognition_id, atlas_id, species_id, herb_name, match_rank, image_similarity, metadata_score, final_score, match_level, is_image_type_matched, is_growth_stage_matched, is_medicinal_part_matched, is_health_status_matched, is_form_type_matched, match_method, warning_msg, suggestion, created_at, updated_at, remark ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{recognitionId}, #{atlasId}, #{speciesId}, #{herbName}, #{matchRank}, #{imageSimilarity}, #{metadataScore}, #{finalScore}, #{matchLevel}, #{isImageTypeMatched}, #{isGrowthStageMatched}, #{isMedicinalPartMatched}, #{isHealthStatusMatched}, #{isFormTypeMatched}, #{matchMethod}, #{warningMsg}, #{suggestion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{remark} )

INSERT INTO herb_image_match ( image_id, recognition_id, atlas_id, species_id, herb_name, match_rank, image_similarity, metadata_score, final_score, match_level, is_image_type_matched, is_growth_stage_matched, is_medicinal_part_matched, is_health_status_matched, is_form_type_matched, match_method, warning_msg, suggestion, created_at, updated_at, remark ) VALUES
( #{match.imageId}, #{match.recognitionId}, #{match.atlasId}, #{match.speciesId}, #{match.herbName}, #{match.matchRank}, #{match.imageSimilarity}, #{match.metadataScore}, #{match.finalScore}, #{match.matchLevel}, #{match.isImageTypeMatched}, #{match.isGrowthStageMatched}, #{match.isMedicinalPartMatched}, #{match.isHealthStatusMatched}, #{match.isFormTypeMatched}, #{match.matchMethod}, #{match.warningMsg}, #{match.suggestion}, #{match.createdAt}, #{match.updatedAt}, #{match.remark} )

SELECT
FROM herb_image_match m INNER JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = m.image_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN herb_atlas a ON a.id = m.atlas_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = a.species_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.image_id = #{imageId} AND m.remark = ( SELECT mm.remark FROM herb_image_match mm WHERE mm.image_id = #{imageId} AND mm.remark IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY m.match_rank ASC
